name: lt01-drought-seed

fort.note: Seeds are world seeds; a seed whose embark finds no acceptable site is skipped, so a pool is the first n accepted seeds of its range. test-private seeds are drawn per season by the maintainers and never written into the repo (embark/pool_task.py --split test-private).

brief: All of the fortress's drink has just been lost.
goal: From day 39 you can't act for 21 days. Keep drink in stock every day of that window, brew at least one batch of drink inside it, and end with at least one drink per dwarf. No dwarf may die.
description: Seed-built LT01 (docs/SEED-FORTS.md). A working year-1 fort (embark/forts/worked-y1: about 19 dwarves; Carpenters, Still, Kitchen, two underground plump-helmet plots; 571 drink) loses all its drink at load (shortage.lua 1 0); 21-day hands-off window from day 39.
provenance: Start: embark/forts/worked-y1.json on a fresh TEMPERATE_SOIL embark of each pool seed (embark/make_task_fort.sh), in place of the scripted-y1 snapshot. Setup unchanged from lt01-drought (shortage.lua 1 0).

legacy.note: The snapshot-based task stays as it was (lab-2.0, dfbench/v2.1.1 results); this one is its seed-built successor with a new task hash.
